description: Switches the narrating voice of an existing project (all presenters; speed kept). `voz` is an id from studio_listar_vozes: a catalogue voice, or one of the user’s own `minha-<id>` voices (only who trained or bought it can use it; checked again by Ania). Applies from the next studio_renderizar; videos already rendered keep their voice. Free.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

name: studio_trocar_voz
title: Studio: switch a project’s voice
